Diego Moreiras Moreiras Perez For Osek Patur, we needed to provide a passport, proof of bank account ownership, and a translated marriage certificate. Your Israeli partner will also need to come (and bring their Teudat Zehut) as they will need to sign some documents.
Don't forget that first you need to register at Maam (מע"מ), and then register at Mas Hahnasa.
